label: Dual-version CI did not pass on main after the 2026-10-19 merge: runs 39294766387 (17:30Z), 39299540911 (18:04Z) and 39308825187 (19:11Z) all failed; the 18:04 run died in the sk-vision bun build (bun: command not found, exit 127) before the battery, and the post-fix 19:11 run executed the battery and exited 1 with all three jobs (v1, v2, both) failing.

Documented v1 --share detached-session flag is absent from installed 1.19.3 run --help (SKILL.md:168, cli-reference.md:113, install-and-versions.md:239, README.md:106, prompt-templates.md:125 all claim it); --share passes without a parse error, so a hidden alias cannot be ruled out, but per the skill's own cli-reference §9 drift procedure the flag is not on the documented surface; runtime effect unverified under the help-only constraint.
Internal contradiction on the skill default model: SKILL.md:158 pins opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash, cli-reference.md:158 and :281 state opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash as the default.

Internal contradiction on the agent-definition directory: SKILL.md:196 and agent-delegation.md:23 say .opencode/agents/<slug>.md, while agent-delegation.md:35, cli-reference.md:289 and opencode-tools.md:171 say .skilled/agents/<slug>.md; both directories exist on disk and the actually-read path is unverified under the help-only constraint.
cli-reference.md:107 marks v2 --log-level 'unverified on OpenCode 2.0.32', but installed 2.0.32 help lists it with choices all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none; the note is stale.

SKILL.md:168's v1 core-flag summary omits --attach, -p/--password, -u/--username and -i/--interactive, all present in installed 1.19.3 run --help (the cli-reference §4 table does carry them; the summary line is the incomplete one).

Positive control: deep-loop opencode-version.cjs matches installed reality — per-directory opencode2-before-opencode PATH scan, OPENCODE_BIN override, VERSION_PATTERN accepting both observed shapes (bare 1.19.3 and opencode v2.0.32).

Positive controls: version baselines, v1-only flags (--command, --variant, --dir, --port, --pure), the v2 surface (#max suffix, --agent, --standalone, --server, -f, --title, --thinking, --format), and cli-reference §8's state-layout claim all match the installed binaries and this machine's layout; the CI both-job assertions use the exact version strings the local binaries print.
